hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; hook="$root/.codex/hooks/index-context.sh"; [ -x "$hook" ] || { echo "Missing Liza Codex hook: $hook. Run 'liza init --codex' to repair project hooks, or remove .codex/hooks.json to disable them." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "$hook"
